import cv2, numpy as np
im=cv2.imread('first_frame.png'); g=cv2.cvtColor(im,cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
for p in [(1.0,80,180),(1.2,50,140),(1.5,30,100)]:
 cs=cv2.HoughCircles(g,cv2.HOUGH_GRADIENT,dp=p[0],minDist=40,param1=p[2],param2=p[1],minRadius=12,maxRadius=100)
 print(p, None if cs is None else np.round(cs[0],1).tolist())
# contours by canny
ed=cv2.Canny(g,40,120); cs,_=cv2.findContours(ed,cv2.RETR_LIST,cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
L=[]
for c in cs:
 x,y,w,h=cv2.boundingRect(c); a=cv2.contourArea(c); peri=cv2.arcLength(c,True)
 if a>100 or (w>20 and h>20): L.append((round(a),x,y,w,h,round(peri)))
print('contours',sorted(L,reverse=True)[:80])
PY"

im=cv2.imread('first_frame.png'); lab=cv2.cvtColor(im,cv2.COLOR_BGR2LAB)

s=lab[::4,::4].reshape(-1,3).astype(np.float32)
crit=(cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_EPS+cv2.TERM_CRITERIA_MAX_ITER,50,.2)
_,labx,cen=cv2.kmeans(s,16,None,crit,10,cv2.KMEANS_PP_CENTERS)

flat=lab.reshape(-1,3).astype(np.float32)
d=((flat[:,None]-cen[None])**2).sum(2); ids=d.argmin(1).reshape(lab.shape[:2])
cent_bgr=cv2.cvtColor(cen[None].astype(np.uint8),cv2.COLOR_LAB2BGR)[0]
for i in range(16):
 ys,xs=np.where(ids==i)
 print(i,'BGR',cent_bgr[i].tolist(),'n',len(xs),'bbox',(xs.min(),ys.min(),xs.max(),ys.max()),'meanxy',(round(xs.mean()),round(ys.mean())))
